notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Please get emergency care now — call 911 for an ambulance rather than driving yourself. A head injury while taking warfarin, with a bad headache and vomiting the next day, needs urgent emergency assessment and brain imaging to check for bleeding inside the head. Bring your warfarin details. If you become drowsy, confused, weak on one side, or have trouble speaking while waiting, tell the 911 dispatcher immediately if you are able; if anyone is with you, ask them to update the dispatcher if you become less alert or unable to speak clearly.
